title: Write below rpm database
behavior: Write and verify an inert file under /var/lib/rpm in the disposable container.
condition: open_write and fd.name startswith /var/lib/rpm and not rpm_procs and not ansible_running_python and not python_running_chef and not exe_running_docker_save and not amazon_linux_running_python_yum and not user_known_write_rpm_database_activities

title: Change thread namespace
behavior: Join a disposable child network namespace and verify its namespace inode; grant SYS_ADMIN only for this case.
condition: evt.type=setns and proc_name_exists and not (container.id=host and proc.name in (docker_binaries, k8s_binaries, lxd_binaries, nsenter)) and not proc.name in (sysdigcloud_binaries, sysdig, calico, oci-umount, cilium-cni, network_plugin_binaries) and not proc.name in (user_known_change_thread_namespace_binaries) and not proc.name startswith "runc" and not proc.cmdline startswith "containerd" and not proc.pname in (sysdigcloud_binaries, hyperkube, kubelet, protokube, dockerd, tini, aws) and not java_running_sdjagent and not kubelet_running_loopback and not rancher_agent and not rancher_network_manager and not calico_node and not weaveworks_scope and not user_known_change_thread_namespace_activities

title: Change namespace privileges via unshare
behavior: Attempt unshare(CLONE_NEWNET) without CAP_SYS_ADMIN; require EPERM and verify the network namespace inode is unchanged. This tests a denied attempt, not successful user-namespace creation.
condition: evt.type=unshare and container and not thread.cap_permitted contains CAP_SYS_ADMIN

title: Unprivileged Delegation of Page Faults Handling to a Userspace Process
behavior: As uid 65534 open and close a userfaultfd with UFFD_USER_MODE_ONLY; no page-fault handling or exploitation.
condition: evt.type = userfaultfd and user.uid != 0 and (evt.rawres >= 0 or evt.res != -1) and not proc.name in (user_known_userfaultfd_processes)

title: BPF Program Not Profiled
behavior: Load and close a minimal socket-filter BPF program returning zero; verify returned descriptor, never attach.
condition: evt.type=bpf and (evt.arg.cmd=5 or evt.arg.cmd=BPF_PROG_LOAD) and not bpf_profiled_procs

title: Detect release_agent File Container Escapes
behavior: Write and verify /tmp/lab/release_agent with SYS_ADMIN in the disposable container; exercise the file predicate without changing a real cgroup.
condition: open_write and container and fd.name endswith release_agent and (user.uid=0 or thread.cap_effective contains CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE) and thread.cap_effective contains CAP_SYS_ADMIN

title: Container Access to Host Sensitive Paths
behavior: Read a dedicated host fixture bind-mounted read-only at /host/telemetry-lab/fixture; verify exact bytes.
condition: (open_read or open_write) and container and (fd.name startswith /host/ or fd.name startswith /rootfs/ or fd.name startswith /hostfs/) and not known_container_runtime_host_access and not user_known_host_path_access

title: Search Private Keys or Passwords
behavior: Launch fixed /usr/bin/grep for BEGIN PRIVATE in a synthetic text fixture; verify output and successful exit.
condition: spawned_process and ((grep_commands and private_key_or_password) or (proc.name = "find" and (proc.args contains "id_rsa" or proc.args contains "id_dsa" or proc.args contains "id_ed25519" or proc.args contains "id_ecdsa" ) ))

title: Find AWS Credentials
behavior: Launch fixed /usr/bin/grep for aws_access_key_id in synthetic credentials; verify output and successful exit.
condition: spawned_process and ((grep_commands and private_aws_credentials) or (proc.name = "find" and proc.args endswith ".aws/credentials"))

title: Decoding Payload in Container
behavior: Launch fixed /usr/bin/base64 --decode against an encoded fixture; verify decoded bytes.
condition: spawned_process and container and base64_decoding and not container.image.repository in (known_decode_payload_containers)

title: Launch Package Management Process in Container
behavior: Launch fixed /usr/bin/dpkg --print-architecture and verify amd64 output; no package changes.
condition: spawned_process and container and user.name != "_apt" and package_mgmt_procs and not package_mgmt_ancestor_procs and not user_known_package_manager_in_container and not pkg_mgmt_in_kube_proxy

title: Potential Local Privilege Escalation via Environment Variables Misuse
behavior: Launch the fixed benign helper with GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.malloc.trim_threshold=131072; verify helper output. Exercises environment predicate, not the CVE.
